sources.title: z-image-turbo: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview z-image-turbo is a 6-billion-parameter text-to-image diffusion model developed by Tongyi-MAI and optimized by prunaai for inference speed. It generates images from text prompts at resolutions up to 2048×2048 pixels, with default generation at 1024×1024. sources.title: Z-Image Turbo Image Model | aicreators.tools
sources.snippet: Z-Image-Turbo came out on Nov 27th 2025 and it lets you generate an image from plain language prompts. It's said to follow instructions well. The model comes from a group called Tongyi-MAI which seems is part of Alibaba's AI setup, likely linked to the wider Tongyi model family that started inside Alibaba Cloud.
